resolution.note: Classified the 37 sessions (.krn/runs/relay-no-merge/classification.md): 35 merged in-session; token-scan.py missed 'Merge pull request #N' subjects (148 of 310 PRs) and credited PRs to successors that viewed them. Corrected scanner: 5 relay sessions over 20 turns without a merge (target <10), 5.24M input tokens per merged PR, not 10.13M. Real stops (retired Jenkins gate, legacy krn ship exit 76) are already gone from the loop. Scanner now exits non-zero when its PR count differs from main's first-parent commits.

title: Find why relay sessions end without a merge and cut the cause
body:
Outcome: lead relay sessions over 20 turns that merge nothing drop from 37 to under 10 per 200 sessions.
Why: 83 lead sessions merged no PR and used 616M cache_read (39%); 37 of them are relay sessions over 20 turns (329M, 53% of that) (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill/token-per-slice.md, section 7; classes are heuristic).
Proof: a classification of the 37 sessions by stop cause (operator wait, CI wait, scope research, handoff churn) saved under .krn/runs/, one fix per top cause, and a rerun of token-scan.py.
Scope: this repository's lead skill, handoff and resume flow.
